AI Notes.value: Founded 2007 by Vinca Kruk and Daniel van der Velden in Amsterdam. One of the most critically recognised design studios in the Netherlands, with work held at MoMA, Guggenheim Bilbao, and Stedelijk Museum. Practice spans graphic design, political/critical research, film (documentary and music videos), installation, and writing. First feature documentary 'The Sprawl' premiered at IFFR 2016; other film works follow. Publications include 'Uncorporate Identity' (2010), 'Can Jokes Bring Down Governments?' (2013), 'Black Transparency' (2015). Current focus: poetry, AI/neural networks, and the Geo-Design MA at Design Academy Eindhoven, where they serve as heads. Also artistic advisors at Rijksakademie. Seniority: senior/director level, ~19 years of practice; among the most prominent speculative design collectives internationally. Autonomy set at 5: self-directed, self-initiated practice; Jonathan would be commissioning them, not directing their process. No LinkedIn company page found (2 searches); studio does not appear to maintain one.
